title: The U.S. left the WHO on Jan. 22, 2026, with loose ends
adds: HHS, State and CDC say U.S. membership in the World Health Organization ended Jan. 22, 2026, after the one-year notice started by a Jan. 20, 2025 executive order. Whether the U.S. paid its required dues, what the WHO's own record shows, and the status of the health regulations and Pandemic Agreement are still open.
